title: Quasi-coherent modules on a Noetherian groupoid scheme with flat qcqs s, t are filtered colimits of coherent modules

statement_spans.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-colimit-coherent (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3225-3235

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: decompose F on U into a filtered colimit of coherent submodules H_i; pull each back through the construct functor (s_*t^*, alpha) and form the fibred product (F, beta) x (s_*t^*H_i, alpha) inside QCoh of the groupoid; exactness of restriction to U (from the proof of lemma-abelian) makes this an intersection diagram, the injective arrow t^*H_i -> s^*F comes from beta by flatness of t, and the push-pull lemma shows each F_i is coherent; since s is qcqs, s_* commutes with filtered colimits, so the identification (F, beta) = colim (F_i, beta_i) follows (source lines 3237-3285)

core_obligations: Decomposition (proof lines 3291-3296): with the Noetherian characterization (01XZ) standing, F = colim H_i with H_i coherent submodules (0GN6).

Intersections (proof lines 3298-3328): form (F_i, beta_i) as the fibred product with (s_*t^*H_i, alpha) of the construct functor (07TR); exactness of restriction (077S proof) gives the intersection reading; via the adjunction map description (0GNF) the diagram identifies with one whose right vertical arrow is s_* of the injective t^*H_i -> s^*F (flatness of t), and 07TT shows F_i is coherent.
Colimit identification (proof lines 3330-3341): s_* commutes with filtered colimits (07TB), so s_*t^*F = colim s_*t^*H_i and (F, beta) = colim (F_i, beta_i).
proof_roadmap: Decompose F into coherent submodules on U (proof lines 3291-3296).
Intersect inside the groupoid category via the construct functor and check coherence (proof lines 3298-3328).
Commute s_* with the colimit to recover (F, beta) (proof lines 3330-3341).
